design_alpha.explicit_null_behavior: Same as omission when design is enabled; otherwise ignored.
design_alpha.omission_behavior: Uses alpha 0.05 when design is enabled.

design_claim_direction.explicit_null_behavior: Rejected when evaluated by a design rule. Ignored without validation when design_enabled is false.
design_claim_direction.meaning: Direction used by directional selected-claim rules
design_claim_direction.omission_behavior: Uses the positive direction unless a one-sided rule fixes direction.

design_claim_threshold.explicit_null_behavior: Same as omission when design is enabled. Ignored without validation when design_enabled is false.
design_claim_threshold.meaning: Threshold used only by threshold-conditioned claim rules
design_claim_threshold.omission_behavior: Uses no threshold; threshold-conditioned rules reject its absence.

design_enabled.explicit_null_behavior: Boolean coercion disables design and ignores all other design fields.
design_enabled.omission_behavior: Returns null for the design response block.

design_information_multiplier.explicit_null_behavior: Same as omission when design is enabled. Ignored without validation when design_enabled is false.
design_information_multiplier.meaning: Scales hypothetical design SE by the inverse square root
design_information_multiplier.omission_behavior: Uses current CI-implied information when design is enabled.

design_max_type_m.explicit_null_behavior: Same as omission when design is enabled. Ignored without validation when design_enabled is false.
design_max_type_m.omission_behavior: Adds no maximum Type M inverse-precision target.

design_max_type_s.explicit_null_behavior: Same as omission when design is enabled. Ignored without validation when design_enabled is false.
design_max_type_s.omission_behavior: Adds no maximum Type S inverse-precision target.

design_plausible_range_lower.explicit_null_behavior: Treated as absent; both bounds must otherwise be supplied. Ignored without validation when design_enabled is false.
design_plausible_range_lower.meaning: Optional design-panel-only true-effect range lower bound

design_plausible_range_upper.explicit_null_behavior: Treated as absent; both bounds must otherwise be supplied. Ignored without validation when design_enabled is false.
design_plausible_range_upper.meaning: Optional design-panel-only true-effect range upper bound

design_precision_target_effect.explicit_null_behavior: Same as omission when design is enabled. Ignored without validation when design_enabled is false.
design_precision_target_effect.meaning: Assumed true effect for inverse precision targets

design_selection_rule.explicit_null_behavior: Rejected when design is enabled. Ignored without validation when design_enabled is false.
design_selection_rule.meaning: One of the six supported selected-claim rules
design_selection_rule.omission_behavior: Uses the two-sided p-value rule when design is enabled.

design_target_power.explicit_null_behavior: Same as omission when design is enabled. Ignored without validation when design_enabled is false.
design_target_power.omission_behavior: Uses 0.80 only when a precision target effect is supplied.

design_true_effects.explicit_null_behavior: Same as omission when design is enabled. Ignored without validation when design_enabled is false.

display_natural_axis.explicit_null_behavior: Boolean coercion selects the working-scale display axis.
display_natural_axis.meaning: Requests natural-scale rather than working-scale x values
display_natural_axis.omission_behavior: Requests a natural display axis for ratio measures.

display_range_lower.explicit_null_behavior: Treated as absent; both bounds must otherwise be supplied together.
display_range_lower.omission_behavior: Uses the automatically constructed observed x-grid.

display_range_upper.explicit_null_behavior: Treated as absent; both bounds must otherwise be supplied together.
display_range_upper.omission_behavior: Uses the automatically constructed observed x-grid.

effect_type.explicit_null_behavior: Rejected as an unsupported effect registry key.
effect_type.meaning: Selects effect family, working scale, label, and default null

estimate.explicit_null_behavior: Same as omission: infer from the CI.
estimate.meaning: Optional point estimate used only to validate the CI midpoint
estimate.omission_behavior: Infers the point estimate from the CI midpoint on the working scale.

grid_points.meaning: Requested grid size, normalized to an odd count

lower.explicit_null_behavior: Rejected because both CI limits are runtime-required.
lower.omission_behavior: Rejected because both CI limits are runtime-required.

null_value.explicit_null_behavior: Same as omission: use the effect registry default null.
null_value.meaning: Candidate null; defaults from the effect registry
null_value.omission_behavior: Uses the selected effect registry default null.

thresholds.explicit_null_behavior: Same as omission: use no reference thresholds.

upper.explicit_null_behavior: Rejected because both CI limits are runtime-required.
upper.omission_behavior: Rejected because both CI limits are runtime-required.

CurveRequest.order_contract: TypedDict declaration order; input mapping order is not relied upon

design.meaning: Repeated-study design block; null when disabled

meta.meaning: Effect, reconstruction, threshold, range, and S-2 metadata

claim_threshold_working.meaning: Directional claim threshold used in tail calculations

current_se_working.meaning: SE reconstructed from the current CI

estimate_working.meaning: Observed CI-implied estimate used only for observed exaggeration

information_multiplier.meaning: Hypothetical information relative to current precision

near_null_delta.meaning: Tolerance for undefined Type S/M ratios

type_m_scale_note.meaning: States additive or log-working-scale Type M semantics

power.meaning: Probability that the selected-claim rule is met

true_effect_display.meaning: Each x value treated as assumed truth

type_m.meaning: Expected selected magnitude divided by true magnitude

DesignGridPayload.order_contract: frozen browser response and CSV alignment order

grid.meaning: Forward operating characteristics on the shared x-grid

scenarios.meaning: Deduplicated null, estimate, threshold, and custom scenarios

warnings.meaning: Design conditioning, semantics, and feasibility notes

achieved_type_m.meaning: Type M at the solved SE

achieved_type_s.meaning: Type S at the solved SE

note.meaning: Already met, bisection, undefined, or infeasible status

required_information_multiplier.meaning: Current SE squared over required SE squared

required_se.meaning: Largest SE estimated to satisfy the target

target.meaning: Power, maximum Type S, or maximum Type M

target_effect_display.meaning: Assumed true effect as supplied before working-scale transformation

target_effect_working.meaning: Assumed true effect used by the solver

DesignPrecisionTargetPayload.order_contract: frozen row key and requested-target order

power.meaning: Probability that the selection rule is met

source.meaning: Null, estimate, threshold, or custom source

DesignScenarioPayload.order_contract: frozen row key order; row order follows source priority

positive_only.meaning: Whether natural-scale inputs must be positive

z.meaning: Standardized distances from the CI-implied estimate

GridPayload.order_contract: frozen order used by CSV export and tests

default_null_applied.meaning: Whether the effect-registry null was applied

display_range_active.meaning: Whether an explicit presentation window is active

display_range_working.meaning: Requested x-grid endpoints used to build the grid

estimate_source.meaning: Whether an estimate was inferred or supplied and validated

s_minus_2_interval.meaning: Effects with log relative support at least -2

se_method.meaning: CI-width or mean-side SE reconstruction method

show_cutoffs.meaning: Whether compatibility guide cutoffs are requested

threshold_support_summaries.meaning: Observed support summaries in input threshold order

range_working.meaning: Finite estimate plus or minus 2 SE endpoints

critical_effect_distance_working.meaning: Legacy z-sum benchmark distance from the null

critical_effect_markers_display.meaning: Legacy paired 80% benchmark markers for display

log_null_relative_likelihood.meaning: Log relative likelihood at the null when finite

null_relative_likelihood.meaning: Normalized Wald relative likelihood at the null

null_z_value.meaning: Signed standardized null distance when finite

two_sided_wald_p_value.meaning: Two-sided compatibility value at the null

working_scale_se.meaning: SE reconstructed from the reported 95% CI

direction_from_estimate.meaning: Threshold position relative to the CI-implied estimate

direction_from_null.meaning: Threshold position relative to the null

log_likelihood_ratio_threshold_to_null.meaning: Log threshold-to-null support when the null summary is finite

relative_likelihood.meaning: Normalized Wald relative likelihood at the threshold
